title: Add .lore/agents/ specialist profiles for opum-workflow dispatch
description: Dispatched by opum-agent (OPAG-417, 2026-09-25). This repo has no .lore/agents/, so lore agent context <profile> --task ... exits 3 ("agent profile ... was not found") for every opum-workflow specialist (implementation, review, verification, documentation) dispatched here -- confirmed on lore 0.9.2. opum-agent's own .lore/agents/*.toml (schema_version, kind = "specialist", max_tokens, pinned, sources) is the worked example. Investigation found this repo's docs/ bundle has no Reference/Story/ADR content beyond the root index and log.md -- README.md and CLAUDE.md carry the real substance (federation contract, federated-pin verification, SDLC/CI gates) in plain markdown, not in the lore bundle -- so profiles need real reference docs authored first or 'sourcing your own docs' has nothing to point at.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/reference/*.md authored under lore Reference type capturing this repo's real contracts (marketplace federation/manifests-check contract, federated-pin verification playbook, SDLC promotion/CI-gate contract) so profiles have real sources
.lore/agents/{implementation,review,verification,documentation}.toml added, matching opum-agent's worked schema (schema_version, kind = specialist, max_tokens, pinned, sources)
lore agent context <profile> --task "<something real>" exits 0 for all four profiles
lore agents --check still exits 0 (OMARK-67's CI gate not broken)
PR opened, required checks green, task closed inside that PR before merge, dev promoted to main
